overall: The AG held the Herring River Technical Team is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it is not within government and lacks a defined membership empowered to act collectively; no order issued.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the newly created Herring River Technical Team is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law and does not intend to comply with it.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Team fails two of the three factors that we consider when determining whether an entity is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law, we find that the Team is not a public body and is not subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint asserted the Team intended not to comply with the Open Meeting Law, though no meetings had been held and no actual violation was alleged.
allegations.key_passage: Rather, the complaint asserted that the Team intended not to comply with the Law.
